answer: Require every agent identity to post a refundable stake bond before it can trade, so each fake identity costs real capital. A single verified inlet admits identities one at a time and checks that the same stake is never reused across accounts, while proven misbehavior burns the bond like an ember going out. An attacker who wants an island of fake accounts must then fund thousands of separate bonds, and that upfront cost exceeds any profit from rigging one vote or market.
